operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:easel && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm check:deployment-spec && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs check && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs verify-base --offline
operations.recovery: Follow docs/backup-and-restore.md: export the complete installation with rer export, retain exact source and private configuration, restore with rer import into a fresh empty installation of the same release, then check the model, approvals and review packs and re-export before routing traffic. Preserve all applied migration names and bytes.
